column3: The first name has to be extract from  Name in source value
The Last name has to be extract from  Name in source value
if source value is Female, it should be replaced by 'WOMAN' in target; if source value is Male, it should be replaced by 'MAN' in target
Age has to be calculated from DOB in source

The value has to be converted into an abbreviated form as below:
if source value = 'Cardiology' target value = 'CD'
if source value = 'Endocrinology' target value = 'END'
if source value = 'Orthopedics' target value = 'ORTH'
if source value = 'Pediatrics' target value = 'PD'
if source value = 'Oncology' target value = 'ONC'
else target value = 'OTH'
